svg.title: imu-fit on a synthetic stationary log
svg.desc: What `kshana imu-fit` reads off a stationary IMU log, from a real run of engine v0.40.0 on a made-up log (20,000 samples at 100 Hz, 200 s): the accelerometer velocity random walk q_va = 4.02e-06, the gyro angle random walk q_arw = 9e-08, the bias instability 0.00296 and the early Allan slopes (-0.51 and -0.49; about -0.5 where white noise dominates). The table beside it is the TOML the command prints. The estimator is checked on synthetic logs only. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
